hero.title: Walking the Work Through Venice
hero.lede: The studio leaves Tesa 41 with the works strapped to its back, sets them down in a campo, on a fondamenta or before a church, and carries them home another way. In the final week students of the Accademia di Belle Arti carry them, and on 18 November walk them into the Academy.

acc.title: Walking the Work to the Accademia
acc.lede: The Accademia di Belle Arti di Venezia hosts Walking the Work Through Venice, a performance of Zadik Zadikian: The Studio. Students of Prof. Gianpaolo Mazzoni’s sculpture course, who helped make the works in Tesa 41, carry them on their backs from the pavilion to the Academy, for an hour with its professors and students.
acc.note: The meeting in the cloister is for the Academy’s students and staff. Anyone may walk alongside on the way there and back.

sched.text: Meet at the door of Tesa 41 on the Fondamenta Case Nuove ten minutes before the time. Anyone may walk alongside; the hour in the Accademia’s cloister on 18 November (11:00–12:00) is for the Academy’s students and staff. The last walk is on the closing day of the Biennale.

join.title: Join us along the way
join.text: Anyone may walk alongside, for the whole way or a stretch of it. Meet at the door of Tesa 41 on the Fondamenta Case Nuove ten minutes before the time, or find us at one of the stops.

alerts.text: An email the day before each walk with the time and the route, and word as soon as a walk moves or changes. Occasional pavilion news too; leave any time.
